📌 Ethena takes USDe basis trade into tokenized US equities 

🔖 Ethena has added tokenized U.S. equities and equity perpetual futures to the basis trading strategy used for part of USDe’s backing, taking a funding model previously centered on crypto markets into listed stocks. According to a statement shared with cryptomedia, Ethena will use Binance’s bStocks as the spot side of the trade while taking offsetting positions through equity perpetual futures on the exchange. 

⭐️ The structure follows a framework previously approved by the Ethena Risk Committee for adding tokenized equity basis trades to the protocol’s allocation strategy. Ethena has historically used a delta neutral approach in crypto markets, pairing asset exposure with derivatives positions intended to hedge movements in the underlying asset. 

📊 Under the new setup, bStocks will provide tokenized equity exposure while Binance’s corresponding perpetual contracts will provide the hedge. The strategy seeks to capture the difference between the spot and perpetual markets without relying primarily on the direction of the underlying stock.

In the early 1900s, the Save the Redwoods League campaigned to save ancient redwoods from logging. Their efforts led to the creation of Humboldt Redwoods State Park in 1921—a park now twice the size of San Francisco.

With more than 100 miles of trails and 250 campsites, it’s a perfect escape for outdoor lovers. Take the short Founder’s Grove Loop to see the enormous Dyerville Giant, or hike the 3.7-mile Bull Creek Trail. You can also drive the 3.1-mile Avenue of the Giants, passing towering trees like the albino Christmas Tree and Spirit Tree.

Enjoy a picnic beneath 300-foot giants, or go fishing and kayaking on the Eel River. Even if you’re not usually drawn to nature, this park is a refreshing place to unwind.

Essentially, this process is already underway. The crypto lending market has grown to $67 billion, and major U.S. banks have already started offering Bitcoin-backed loans.

The market itself is also starting to pick up. BTC is up 40% this quarter alone, while Bitcoin ETFs saw another $2.4 billion in inflows last week.
